dedupe_keys.name: rapid n rapid natech risk assessment tool

description: RAPID-N is the European Commission Joint Research Centre's web-based tool for rapid risk assessment of natural-hazard triggered technological accidents (natechs), that is releases of hazardous substances, fires and explosions at chemical and other industrial facilities caused by natural hazards. The online system combines hazard data (hazard maps, on-site hazard data and a live list of recent earthquakes with their magnitude and depth), industrial plant, pipeline and plant unit inventories, typical plant units, substances and property estimators, fragility curves, damage classifications and risk states, and a record of past natechs and natech damages, to estimate damage probabilities and consequences for industrial units. Anyone can browse; users register or log in with an EU login to run and store their own assessments. Documentation is the user manual by Girgin (2011) and a usage guide by Necci and Krausmann (2022), with tutorial videos. No licence is stated on the home page read. Caveats: fragility curves and plant data depend on user and literature contributions, and results are screening-level estimates. For simulation it links natural hazards to industrial facility damage for natech, cascading and emergency response scenarios. Related catalogue records include eNATECH and ALOHA.
